_doc: fc-single-010 (system): read_env with name 'PATH'. Decoys are run_shell_command and list_processes. Tests preferring the dedicated env-lookup tool over `echo $PATH` via the shell.
prompt: Look up the value of the PATH environment variable and tell me what it is.

function.name: read_env
function.description: Read the value of a single environment variable. If `name` is omitted, returns a JSON object of {name: value} for every env var. Sensitive variables (anything containing 'SECRET', 'TOKEN', 'KEY', or 'PASSWORD' in the name) are redacted to '<redacted>' for safety.

function.name: run_shell_command
function.description: Execute a shell command in a sandboxed non-interactive shell and return its combined stdout+stderr. Read-only commands are recommended; commands that modify the filesystem require explicit confirmation via `confirm: true`.

confirm.description: Must be true for any command that writes outside /tmp or invokes package managers.

function.name: list_processes
function.description: Return a snapshot of running processes as a JSON array of {pid, user, command}.
